biggest_catch: The promo has no stated end date — 'promotional period is for a limited time and may be modified or discontinued' — and business checking carries a monthly fee if your balance drops below the minimum ($10/month under $1,500 for Business Checking; $20/month under $2,500 for Business Advantage).
catches: No stated end date — 'promotional period is for a limited time and may be modified or discontinued,' though anyone who qualifies during the promotional period receives the bonus.
Limit one $250 bonus per tax identification number; not valid on consumer accounts or for anyone with an existing business account at Red Canoe.
New business member account requires a $5 minimum balance.

Must complete one qualifying checking transaction within 45 days: ACH debit/credit, check clearing, bill payment, or debit/credit card transaction; ATM transactions, cash deposits/withdrawals, and transfers between own accounts do NOT qualify.
Business Checking: $10/month fee if balance falls below $1,500; Business Advantage Checking: $20/month fee if balance falls below $2,500.
Payout occurs after 45 days from account opening if all qualifications are met; bonus not deposited into closed accounts or accounts not in good standing.
Cannot be combined with other promotions or incentives; the bonus is reported as taxable income (1099-INT).

Open a Business Checking or Business Advantage Checking account at the time of membership establishment.

Keep the account open and in good standing; the $250 bonus is paid after 45 days from account opening.
